courses.summary: 以露天銅礦與鄰近處理系統的介面為主題，追蹤乾礦、金屬與輸送量。 五組案例問題依序建立控制體、重算數值、檢查量測與診斷失效；計算參數是公開原理下的合成教學基準，並非該礦實際產能、設計條件或操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: Focus on interfaces between an open-pit copper mine and nearby processing, tracking dry ore, metal and transport. Five case investigations define boundaries, recalculate quantities, check measurements and diagnose failures. Numerical inputs are synthetic teaching benchmarks based on public principles, not the mine’s actual capacity, design conditions or operating settings.
